svg.title: Longhorn and Kopiur failure domains
svg.desc: Longhorn and CSI snapshots remain inside Kubernetes. Kopiur copies protected application and Postgres volumes to RustFS and restores replacement PVCs before binding. A single Longhorn replica cannot survive the loss of its host.
